description: This file contains an abstract test class for unit testing Android fragments using Robolectric. It provides methods to start fragments, manage activity lifecycle, and run basic lifecycle tests.

classes.name: RobolectricFragmentActivityTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit testing fragments within an activity using Robolectric, providing lifecycle management and test utilities.

methods.name: afterRobolectricFragmentActivityTestCase
methods.description: Cleans up the activity controller after tests, destroying the activity.

methods.name: startFragment
methods.description: Starts the fragment with default (null) saved state.

methods.name: getCurrentFragment
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current fragment instance.

methods.name: startFragmentWithState
methods.description: Starts the fragment with a specified saved state bundle.

methods.name: createActivityController
methods.description: Abstract method to create the activity controller.

methods.name: getActivityController
methods.description: Returns the current activity controller instance.

methods.name: ensureAllScheduledJobsAreDone
methods.description: Ensures all scheduled RxJava jobs are completed.

methods.name: testEnsurePortraitFragmentHandlesHappyPathLifecycle
methods.description: Test that the fragment handles the portrait lifecycle correctly.

methods.name: testEnsureLandscapeFragmentHandlesHappyPathLifecycle
methods.description: Test that the fragment handles the landscape lifecycle correctly.

methods.name: testEnsureFragmentHandlesHappyPathLifecycleWithResume
methods.description: Test fragment lifecycle with pause, resume, and stop.

methods.name: testEnsureFragmentHandlesRecreateWithInstanceState
methods.description: Test fragment recreation with saved instance state.
